This packet follows the ordinary #79 decision at
https://github.com/MGYamada/Qleisli/issues/79#issuecomment-6009973288.
Six complete first projects, predictions and this context are preserved before
any client command. They are independent controls/counterexamples, not repairs.

The author is a Codex subagent with prior access to #79/#67/#68, the adopted
ordinary decisions, shared checker, lexer/parser, type/primitive Reference,
existing exact Unit-map and Iso-preparation tests, and authoring records.
The exact deployed model identifier and sampling settings are unavailable.

independent semantic oracle, formal proof or source-preservation theorem.

Constitutional originals and ratification/adoption/admission/current evidence
were reread in the preceding #79 audit. The continuity check passed against
trusted faa5cfb5e7ea1cf3b39a43b80f7f2345e89197c2. Adopted QS-2026-01,
PR-2026-01, RS-2026-01 and EXACT-2026-01 retain broader pending duties; the two

This ordinary study adopts no interpretation or guarantee and claims no
broader discharge or release approval.

Ordinary Bit/Unit values can be constructed, copied or ignored. A valid helper
named default has only its checked body, types and inferred effects; its name
is not a builtin trait or factory. Explicit init0 has principal Iso action,
including through a caller. Generic Basis declarations are checked even when
unused. No Default trait/impl/associated-item facility is admitted. Its grammar
absence is not an implementation of hypothetical future trait resolution.

Q<Unit> is a linear logical owner despite no physical wire. unit(()) is an
explicit exact +1, Unitary structural introduction, not Iso qubit allocation.
finish explicitly consumes that owner but retains preceding scalar action.
Nested products containing it cannot be ignored by a wildcard. The declared
scalar expectation for the Unit positive is exp(i*pi/4) on its sole coefficient,
with a fresh returned owner; this expectation precedes commands. A floating
run is a supplemental observation, not independent exact semantic evidence.
Existing Unit-map/native-request/reference tests retain their separate status.

Every project declares schema-2 edition 2026 and has zero or one physical
qubit. Four projects use ordinary project check; the two Unit projects use
selected check with --entry=main::entry and --module=main=<source>. Every source
gets JSON and default text check. Successful ordinary and preparation controls
may run in JSON; the Unit scalar run is attempted only if actual selected check
succeeds. Unsupported outcomes and prediction mistakes remain original records.
No repair is assumed or hidden. There is no standalone release API, implicit
clean workspace, new primitive or generic quantum initialization.

External qlippy is omitted under maintainer authorization; actual compiler
messages remain in scope. This observer does not build Cargo/Lean, run Cargo
Clippy, generate maximum-size systems, replay historical experiments or resume
generic QFT. AFTER uses a separately supplied fixed executable, the same
sources/commands and a separately captured result. Code/category/span/acceptance
and successful outputs are predicted unchanged; only the rejected-default
teaching message is expected to mention quantum-containing products/Q<Unit>.
